QF.id: IV Code of Conduct and Investor Protection_22

question.text: A stock broker shall have adequately trained staff and arrangements to render:

answer.text: Premium services to large clients only

explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI code of conduct requires a stock broker to maintain adequately trained staff and arrangements to render fair, prompt, and competent services to clients. This is a general obligation applicable regardless of client size or order value. The Trap: "Maximum profit-generating services" elevates revenue over fairness. Limiting service to large clients or to bare execution without competence breaches the same fair-service obligation in the code.
